- scripts/ai_memory_lib.py:_inject_token_into_url at lines 3039-3052; _resolve_origin_url at lines 3074-3087 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, moonshotai_kimi-k3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_6]
  PROBLEM: HTTPS GitHub remotes now embed tokens as `x-access-token:TOKEN@host` instead of using per-process `http.extraHeader` authentication.
  WHY: Tokens can appear in argv, `/proc/PID/cmdline`, `.git/config`, reflogs, diagnostics, and remote output; this also breaks authentication paths relying on `persist-credentials: false`.

  PROBLEM: `_memory_git` was deleted, force-tick URLs embed tokens, and branch operations use bare unauthenticated Git commands.
  WHY: With `persist-credentials: false`, `git ls-remote` and `git push` fail, leaving `ai-memory` unavailable; embedded tokens leak through process arguments and diagnostics.
